Hello France Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0373309 ﻿from the

As the customer mentioned that the XF3 is not detecting the SIM inside the SIM card slot, there might be chances that the SIM card slot is being damaged & we need to replace it. While going on site please make sure to arrange spare router, one extra SIM card & couple of Ethernet cables.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
